journey.name: receive tabs wraparound
journey.description:
On the Receive sheet, tab swipes wrap around: a swipe to the right on the first tab selects the last tab, and a swipe to the left on the last tab selects the first. A sideways swipe never closes the Receive sheet, also when it is released above the sheet, and a tap on a QR still copies it.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with USDT enabled (introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments), no open Spending channel, no CJIT invoice pending and no hardware wallet paired, so the tabs are Savings, Spending and USDT; a usable channel adds the Auto tab. Start on the wallet home screen. The USDT address loads without funding; wait for the QR before swiping.
Swipe with AXe across the middle of the QR, about 60% of its width, in 300 ms (`axe swipe --start-x 80 --start-y 440 --end-x 330 --end-y 440 --duration 0.3 --udid ` to the right on a 402 pt wide simulator).
iOS: the paged `TabView` holds an extra page before the first tab and after the last one; paging onto either selects the tab at the other end.

actions.action: Tap Receive (id "Receive") and verify the Savings tab (id "Tab-savings") is selected
Swipe right across the Savings QR; verify the USDT tab (id "Tab-usdt") is selected and wait until the USDT QR is visible
Swipe left across the USDT QR; verify the Savings tab is selected
Swipe left across the Savings QR in 600 ms (`axe swipe --start-x 330 --start-y 440 --end-x 80 --end-y 440 --duration 0.6`); verify the Spending tab (id "Tab-spending") is selected
Swipe left across the Spending content in 600 ms; verify the USDT tab is selected and wait until its QR is visible

Swipe left from the top right of the USDT QR to above the sheet (`axe swipe --start-x 360 --start-y 300 --end-x 30 --end-y 60 --duration 0.3`); verify the Receive sheet is still open and the Savings tab is selected

Swipe right from the top left of the Savings QR to above the sheet (`axe swipe --start-x 40 --start-y 300 --end-x 380 --end-y 60 --duration 0.3`); verify the Receive sheet is still open and the USDT tab is selected
Swipe left across the USDT QR, then tap the Savings QR once; verify the "copied" tooltip appears
Close Receive, turn USDT off (Settings, General, Payments), return to the wallet home screen and tap Receive; verify the Savings tab is selected and only Savings and Spending show
Swipe right across the Savings QR; verify the Spending tab is selected
Swipe right across the Spending content; verify the Savings tab is selected
Swipe left across the Savings QR; verify the Spending tab is selected
Swipe left across the Spending content; verify the Savings tab is selected
Swipe left across the Savings QR; verify the Spending tab is selected
